entities.summary: Sarah Davies is a British weightlifter, competing in the 64 kg and 69 kg categories internationally and representing England and Great Britain at international competitions. She is a Commonwealth Games champion at 71 kg from 2022, and a european Champion at 64 kg from 2025. She won the silver medal in the women's 71 kg event at the 2021 World Weightlifting Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
